sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 814 physical subject rows / 808 family-card identities across 18 sections retain original Name/Team cells, 300 base numbers and 224 literal Rookie marks. All six dual cards retain both signers. Historical teams, trademarks and card-specific assignments remain unchanged. All 89 odds categories retain the literal FGC006155 Hobby header and values, including 01:16:00; no ratio unit is printed. Six product-description 1/1 terms join only Base Pristine Black, the four named short-print Superfractors and All Star Game Pristine Pieces. Other color limits are not inferred. The guide’s 10 cards per tri-pack and store’s 8 cards per pack retain their original units without choosing a corrected count. February 12 store availability and Product Year 2026 remain separate from the 2025 title and verified February 4, 2026 release. Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified.

Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified. Product description gives only the six imported 1/1 joins; no other color limits are inferred, including the base Superfractor whose numeric limit is unstated in the checked wording.
The 27 All-Star Game subject rows join only their separate All Star Game Pristine Pieces program; its 1/1 statement never numbers regular Pristine Pieces.
The spotlight gives 10 cards per tri-pack, while the store gives 8 cards per pack. Preserve each source and its pack unit; do not choose a corrected count or derive category odds.
The odds header names FGC006155 Hobby but no ratio unit. Preserve all 89 literal values, especially three-part cells, without computing per-pack probabilities.
Keep February 12 store availability / store Product Year 2026 separate from the 2025 title and existing explicit February 4, 2026 release evidence.
